$comment: Opt-in with `eval-ai.ts --network large`. Adds `distractors` generated look-alikes (deterministic, from `pools`) and the `contacts` below to contact-search-eval.json's network, so retrieval has to choose a dozen out of ~320 instead of returning nearly everyone. The pools share no company, school, location or industry with the base network (seedNetwork throws if one does), so every base case keeps its answer. The `contacts` here look like distractors on their profile; what sets each apart lives ONLY in an interaction note (`notes`), so their cases pass only when the note reaches the answer. `cases` run in the chat task on top of ai-chat-eval.json's: note-only facts asked as profile questions (the fast path), follow-ups that name nobody, and the network's size. `mustSay` is scored like the research task's; `{networkSize}` is replaced with the number of contacts seeded.
